name: grevia-monorepo
description: Grevia — Interactive Climate Education Platform Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:web"

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend/api run build && npm --prefix backend/ai run build && npm --prefix frontend/web run build
